evidence.note: Real ERP УХ 3.2.12.6 1cv8.cf storage entries, extracted with `ibcmd-rs cf extract <cf> <form-uuid>.0 <outdir>` (compression raw-deflate). `FormConditionalGroupSchema::from_raw_layout` (src/form_schema.rs) admitted the wrapper-`22` conditional `UserVisible`-common prefix tuple (slot 5, `{0,{0,{"B",v},0}}`) only for shifted-discriminator `2`|`3`|`4`|`5` (ColumnGroup/Pages/Page/UsualGroup) and, in a second arm, `8`|`9` (Table's own ContextMenu/AutoCommandBar) -- never for `0` (CommandBar), `1` (Popup) or `6` (ButtonGroup), even though the neighbouring FormChildItemVisibleSchema already lists all seven kinds together for the identical tuple. Without the shift, `form_child_item_tag`/`parse_form_child_item_name` read the discriminator/name slot one member early -- landing on the prefix tuple's own opening brace, never a bare `"0"`..`"9"` digit or a quoted name -- and both refused, so `parse_form_child_item_with_metadata_owners` returned `None` for the whole item. `parse_form_child_item_pairs`'s exact-count-or-best-effort-partial bookkeeping then silently dropped that one item from its parent's child list (`.unwrap_or_default()`/partial-match fallback, doctrine point 2/6: a silent default, not a typed refusal) -- taking every nested item the dropped one owned down with it. All three objects below are confirmed on real bytes at field_count 35 (the `31 + 2k`, `k=2` progression the accepted discriminators already run on), tuple flag `Some(true)` (the default state the platform writes no `<UserVisible>` for).
